panels.title: Throughput — events per minute, by endpoint

targets.rawSql: SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(received_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00')) AS time, awc_action AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM vinplay.awc_event_log WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND awc_action REGEXP '$endpoint' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

WITH ranked AS (SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(received_at)/60)*60) AS bucket, awc_action, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, received_at, response_at)/1000 AS ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(received_at)/60), awc_action ORDER BY TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, received_at, response_at)) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(received_at)/60), awc_action) AS total FROM vinplay.awc_event_log WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND processing_status='COMPLETED' AND response_at IS NOT NULL AND awc_action REGEXP '$endpoint') SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(bucket) AS time, awc_action AS metric, MAX(CASE WHEN rn=CEIL(total*0.50) THEN ms END) AS value FROM ranked GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

WITH ranked AS (SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(received_at)/60)*60) AS bucket, awc_action, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, received_at, response_at)/1000 AS ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(received_at)/60), awc_action ORDER BY TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, received_at, response_at)) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(received_at)/60), awc_action) AS total FROM vinplay.awc_event_log WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND processing_status='COMPLETED' AND response_at IS NOT NULL AND awc_action REGEXP '$endpoint') SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(bucket) AS time, awc_action AS metric, MAX(CASE WHEN rn=CEIL(total*0.90) THEN ms END) AS value FROM ranked GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: p99 latency by endpoint (ms)  ← page when >100ms sustained

targets.rawSql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(received_at)/60)*60) AS bucket, awc_action, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, received_at, response_at)/1000 AS ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(received_at)/60), awc_action ORDER BY TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, received_at, response_at)) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(received_at)/60), awc_action) AS total FROM vinplay.awc_event_log WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND processing_status='COMPLETED' AND response_at IS NOT NULL AND awc_action REGEXP '$endpoint') SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(bucket) AS time, awc_action AS metric, MAX(CASE WHEN rn=CEIL(total*0.99) THEN ms END) AS value FROM ranked GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(received_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00')) AS time, awc_action AS metric, MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, received_at, response_at)/1000) AS value FROM vinplay.awc_event_log WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND processing_status='COMPLETED' AND response_at IS NOT NULL AND awc_action REGEXP '$endpoint' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(received_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00')) AS time, CONCAT(awc_action, '/', processing_status) AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM vinplay.awc_event_log WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND processing_status IN ('FAILED', 'RECEIVED') AND awc_action REGEXP '$endpoint' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT awc_action AS metric, SUM(CASE WHEN ms < 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `<50ms`, SUM(CASE WHEN ms BETWEEN 50 AND 99 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `50-100ms`, SUM(CASE WHEN ms BETWEEN 100 AND 499 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `100-500ms`, SUM(CASE WHEN ms BETWEEN 500 AND 999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `500ms-1s`, SUM(CASE WHEN ms BETWEEN 1000 AND 2999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `1-3s`, SUM(CASE WHEN ms BETWEEN 3000 AND 9999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `3-10s`, SUM(CASE WHEN ms >= 10000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `>10s_DANGER` FROM (SELECT awc_action, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, received_at, response_at)/1000 AS ms FROM vinplay.awc_event_log WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND processing_status='COMPLETED' AND awc_action REGEXP '$endpoint') t GROUP BY awc_action

SELECT received_at AS `Time (VN)`, awc_action AS `Endpoint`, processing_status AS `Status`, member_account AS `Player`, product_code AS `Product`, gsc_wager_code AS `Wager`, ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, received_at, response_at)/1000, 1) AS `Latency (ms)`, last_error AS `Error` FROM vinplay.awc_event_log WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND awc_action REGEXP '$endpoint' ORDER BY (response_at - received_at) DESC LIMIT 50
